methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: a Probit model to identify the determinants of adoption, as well as a 2SLS model to address endogeneity

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Purely economic study estimating the impact of adopting energy management measures (a binary adoption variable) on firm turnover, net income, and production costs via a Probit adoption model and 2SLS instrumental-variable regressions on World Bank Enterprise Survey data. No EnPI or EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised; ISO 50001 is cited only as normative context for the concept.

paper_type.evidence_quote: In this study, 3917 firms from 135 SSA countries were analyzed

stage1.notes: Cross-country econometric impact study (Probit + 2SLS) on WB Enterprise Survey 2023. EMM is a firm-level adoption dummy, not an energy performance indicator/baseline model. Manufacturing and service firms across SSA; no continuous-process context.
